draft.internal_note: Customer reports discount code WELCOME10 not working and wants to place an order for the Firefly Rechargeable Lantern (SKU FL-300). No order exists in the system, so we cannot apply any discount retroactively. According to store policies, discount codes must be applied at checkout and cannot be added after purchase. Advise the customer to ensure the code is entered correctly, check for any restrictions (e.g., one code per order), and note that we cannot manually apply or adjust pricing. No knowledge gap.
draft.reply:
Hi Nina,

Thanks for reaching out. Our discount codes need to be entered at checkout and can only be used once per order. Please double‑check that the code WELCOME10 is typed correctly and that no other code has already been applied. If the code still won’t work, it may be expired or not applicable to the item you’re purchasing.

You can add the Firefly Rechargeable Lantern (SKU FL-300) to your cart and try applying the code again. Let us know if you continue to have trouble, and we’ll look into it further.

Best regards,
Driftwood Supply Support
